'''Granite''' was a rock used for facade of buildings on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>

It was exposed at [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] along the [[Kelita River]]<ref name="S">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> and on [[Endregaad]].<ref name="TF">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref>
